listing.name: Metroid Prime — prime-recomp (ethannicholas) (ethannicholas)
listing.summary: The project claims the whole game is complete without significant bugs. Development focuses on VR. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Rev 2 Player’s Choice GM8E01 v1.02 disc as ISO or CISO. The required main.dol SHA1 is 39a2f928159ad46491e9b1ef0a72613d91e0cc40.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code and build locally from source, keeping the original image available during play. Do not redistribute the generated game binary.

warnings: The project claims the whole game is complete without significant bugs. Development focuses on VR.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
